content: Human-labeling session — econ-second-base-race:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a second-base race with seed-rotated base corner. You hold a Construction Yard, a Power Plant and one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) in either the NORTH-WEST or SOUTH-WEST corner of the map, with $2000 in the bank. A near-base ore patch sits next to your spawn. A RICH CONTESTED patch sits on the OPPOSITE diagonal — SE at (88, 30) if you spawn NW, NE at (88, 8) if you spawn SW. Within about 40 turns, own a second Ore Refinery inside the disk of radius 6 around your matched contested patch, and reach economy value $4500.
